capabilities: Automatically review new or changed paragraphs and list items while writing
Show AI feedback as hover popovers with dotted underlines
Insert chosen AI feedback into notes as Markdown bullets or paragraphs
Review a selection or the whole note on demand
Ask AI questions about selected text or the whole note
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or proofreading review tool; it adds AI explanatory hover comments to passages you have written.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.13.7+); mobile and Reading view unsupported. Live-tested only on macOS; Windows may need a native codex.exe path. Automatic reviews start disabled and require a one-time Connect and enable consent step. Feedback flags uncertain details rather than presenting fact checks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI-generated background explanations and examples attached directly to passages while you write, without an API key or chat panel.

relations.evidence: Install the official Codex CLI and sign in with codex login. The plugin does not install Codex for you.

requires.name: Codex subscription or other account access

summary: AI study-feedback plugin that adds hover annotations with context, explanations, and examples to note passages, using a local Codex CLI sign-in.
